name: blinko-lite
description: AI智能笔记 - 课设简化版(基于 Blinko 1.8.8 精简)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,app -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:app"
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:app
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd prisma && bunx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd prisma && bunx prisma migrate reset --force
